### `uploadProviderDocuments`

**Mutation** · **Who can call it:** SERVICE_PROVIDER only (ADMIN and SUPER_ADMIN get `UNAUTHORIZED`) · **Strict rate limit:** 20 per minute

Uploads verification documents, such as a government ID or CAC certificate, sent as base64 text, to the signed-in provider's profile for admins to review. The files are stored privately.

**Arguments**

| Argument | Type | Required | Rules and notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `files` | `[FileUploadInput!]!` | Yes | A profile holds at most 5 documents, so send at most 5 minus the number you already have. An empty list succeeds and uploads nothing. |

`FileUploadInput`

| Field | Type | Required | Rules and notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `base64Data` | `String!` | Yes | Base64 file content, with or without a `data:<MIME type>;base64,` prefix. Without a prefix the MIME type comes from the extension, including `.doc` and `.docx`. At most 15 MB per file (estimated). |
| `filename` | `String!` | Yes | Extension must be `jpg`, `jpeg`, `png`, `pdf`, `doc` or `docx` (any case). |

**Example**

```graphql
mutation UploadProviderDocuments($files: [FileUploadInput!]!) {
  uploadProviderDocuments(files: $files) {
    success
    urls
    message
  }
}
```

Variables:

```json
{
  "files": [
    {
      "base64Data": "data:application/pdf;base64,JVBERi0xLjcKJeLjz9MKMSAwIG9iago...",
      "filename": "cac-certificate.pdf"
    }
  ]
}
```

**Success**

Response:

```json
{
  "data": {
    "uploadProviderDocuments": {
      "success": true,
      "urls": [
        "https://api.cloudinary.com/v1_1/easykonnet-demo/image/download?api_key=123456789012345&expires_at=1789219800&format=pdf&public_id=easykonect%2Fdocuments%2F64f1c2a9e4b0a1b2c3d4e5f6_1789218000345_9f8e7d&signature=3b9c0d1e2f3a4b5c6d7e8f9a0b1c2d3e4f5a6b7c&timestamp=1789218000&type=authenticated"
      ],
      "message": "1 document(s) uploaded successfully"
    }
  }
}
```

Message: `{count} document(s) uploaded successfully`

- Every file's extension and size are checked before anything is uploaded.
- Files are uploaded one at a time to the Cloudinary folder `easykonect/documents` as private files (Cloudinary detects the file type) and added to the end of the profile's `documents`.
- `urls` are links to the new documents that expire after 30 minutes. Use them for an immediate preview; later, read `documents` for fresh links.
- If any upload fails, or the profile can't be saved, the files already uploaded by this request are deleted again and `documents` isn't changed.
- This doesn't submit the profile for verification or change `verificationStatus`. Call `submitProviderForVerification` (providers and services section) when the documents are ready.

**Errors**

| Code | Message | When |
|---|---|---|
| `UNAUTHENTICATED` | You must be logged in to perform this action | No valid access token |
| `UNAUTHORIZED` | You do not have permission to perform this action | Signed in with any role other than SERVICE_PROVIDER |
| `PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE` | Request body too large | The request body is over 20 MB. Returned with HTTP status 413 before GraphQL runs |
| `RATE_LIMITED` | Too many requests. Please try again in {seconds} seconds. | More than 20 upload mutations in a minute. Returned with HTTP status 429 and a `Retry-After` header |
| `PROVIDER_NOT_FOUND` | Provider profile not found | The account has no provider profile |
| `MAX_DOCUMENTS_EXCEEDED` | Maximum 5 documents allowed. You have {currentCount} and are trying to add {fileCount}. | Existing plus new documents would be more than 5 |
| `INVALID_FILE_FORMAT` | Invalid file format. Allowed formats for document: jpg, jpeg, png, pdf, doc, docx | A filename has another extension |
| `FILE_TOO_LARGE` | File size exceeds maximum allowed (15MB) | A file's estimated size is over 15 MB |
| `UPLOAD_FAILED` | {Cloudinary's error message}, or Failed to upload file if Cloudinary gave none | Cloudinary refused a file |

**Notes**

- **Who can see documents:** `documents` on `ServiceProviderProfile` is returned only to ADMIN and SUPER_ADMIN and to the provider who owns the profile. Everyone else gets `[]`. The browse types (`BrowseProviderItem`, `PublicProviderProfile`, `LikedProviderDetails`) have no documents field.
- **What `documents` contains:** documents uploaded privately come back as download links that expire 30 minutes after the response. Documents uploaded before private storage was introduced are ordinary Cloudinary URLs and come back unchanged. Don't store the links: fetch the profile again when you need them.
- A document's link can be passed to `removeProviderDocument`, even after it has expired.
- Large documents: send one per request, or upload directly with `getDocumentUploadParams` and `addProviderDocuments`.

### `addProviderDocuments`

**Mutation** · **Who can call it:** SERVICE_PROVIDER only (ADMIN and SUPER_ADMIN get `UNAUTHORIZED`) · **Strict rate limit:** none

Adds verification documents that were uploaded straight to Cloudinary with the parameters from `getDocumentUploadParams` to the signed-in provider's profile.

**Arguments**

| Argument | Type | Required | Rules and notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `documentUrls` | `[String!]!` | Yes | The `secure_url` Cloudinary returned for each upload. See the rules below. An empty list succeeds and saves nothing. |

Each URL must:

- be a Cloudinary delivery URL on this backend's Cloudinary account (`https://res.cloudinary.com/{cloudName}/…`), at most 2,048 characters long;
- point to a private (`authenticated`) file, as `getDocumentUploadParams` produces;
- point to a file directly inside the `easykonect/documents` folder whose name starts with your user ID, as the `publicId` from `getDocumentUploadParams` does;
- be an image (jpg, jpeg, png), a PDF, or a raw file (Word documents).

A document that is already on the profile, or repeated in the list, is skipped. The profile holds at most 5 documents.

**Example**

```graphql
mutation AddProviderDocuments($documentUrls: [String!]!) {
  addProviderDocuments(documentUrls: $documentUrls) {
    success
    urls
    message
  }
}
```

Variables:

```json
{
  "documentUrls": [
    "https://res.cloudinary.com/easykonnet-demo/image/authenticated/s--Ab12Cd34--/v1789218000/easykonect/documents/64f1c2a9e4b0a1b2c3d4e5f6_1789218000345_9f8e7d.pdf",
    "https://res.cloudinary.com/easykonnet-demo/raw/authenticated/s--Ef56Gh78--/v1789218004/easykonect/documents/64f1c2a9e4b0a1b2c3d4e5f6_1789218003456_1a2b3c"
  ]
}
```

**Success**

Response:

```json
{
  "data": {
    "addProviderDocuments": {
      "success": true,
      "urls": [
        "https://api.cloudinary.com/v1_1/easykonnet-demo/image/download?api_key=123456789012345&expires_at=1789219800&format=pdf&public_id=easykonect%2Fdocuments%2F64f1c2a9e4b0a1b2c3d4e5f6_1789218000345_9f8e7d&signature=3b9c0d1e2f3a4b5c6d7e8f9a0b1c2d3e4f5a6b7c&timestamp=1789218000&type=authenticated",
        "https://api.cloudinary.com/v1_1/easykonnet-demo/raw/download?api_key=123456789012345&expires_at=1789219800&public_id=easykonect%2Fdocuments%2F64f1c2a9e4b0a1b2c3d4e5f6_1789218003456_1a2b3c&signature=9d8c7b6a5f4e3d2c1b0a9f8e7d6c5b4a3f2e1d0c&timestamp=1789218000&type=authenticated"
      ],
      "message": "2 document(s) added successfully"
    }
  }
}
```

Message: `{count} document(s) added successfully`, where `{count}` counts only newly added documents.

- The new documents are added to the end of the profile's `documents`, in the order sent.
- `urls` are links to the newly added documents that expire after 30 minutes. Skipped documents aren't included.
- This doesn't submit the profile for verification or change `verificationStatus`.

**Errors**

| Code | Message | When |
|---|---|---|
| `UNAUTHENTICATED` | You must be logged in to perform this action | No valid access token |
| `UNAUTHORIZED` | You do not have permission to perform this action | Signed in with any role other than SERVICE_PROVIDER |
| `PROVIDER_NOT_FOUND` | Provider profile not found | The account has no provider profile |
| `INVALID_DOCUMENT_URL` | Document URLs must be files you uploaded with getDocumentUploadParams | Any URL breaks the rules above. Nothing is saved |
| `MAX_DOCUMENTS_EXCEEDED` | Maximum 5 documents allowed. You have {currentCount} and are trying to add {newCount}. | Existing plus new (not skipped) documents would be more than 5. Nothing is saved |

**Notes**

- Save all of a batch's documents in one call once their uploads have finished, and retry the same call if the response is lost: documents already saved are skipped.
- If you pass a link from `documents` or `urls` instead of Cloudinary's `secure_url`, the call fails with `INVALID_DOCUMENT_URL`.

### `removeProviderDocument`

**Mutation** · **Who can call it:** SERVICE_PROVIDER only (ADMIN and SUPER_ADMIN get `UNAUTHORIZED`) · **Strict rate limit:** none

Removes one verification document from the signed-in provider's profile.

**Arguments**

| Argument | Type | Required | Rules and notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `documentUrl` | `String!` | Yes | One of the entries in the profile's `documents`, or a link returned for it in `documents` or `urls`, including one that has expired. |

**Example**

```graphql
mutation RemoveProviderDocument($documentUrl: String!) {
  removeProviderDocument(documentUrl: $documentUrl) {
    success
    message
  }
}
```

Variables:

```json
{
  "documentUrl": "https://api.cloudinary.com/v1_1/easykonnet-demo/image/download?api_key=123456789012345&expires_at=1789219800&format=pdf&public_id=easykonect%2Fdocuments%2F64f1c2a9e4b0a1b2c3d4e5f6_1789218000345_9f8e7d&signature=3b9c0d1e2f3a4b5c6d7e8f9a0b1c2d3e4f5a6b7c&timestamp=1789218000&type=authenticated"
}
```

**Success**

Response:

```json
{
  "data": {
    "removeProviderDocument": {
      "success": true,
      "message": "Document removed successfully"
    }
  }
}
```

Message: `Document removed successfully`

- The document is removed from the profile's `documents`.
- Then the Cloudinary file is deleted if you uploaded it (file name starts with your user ID), whether it is an image, a PDF or a Word document, private or public. Delete failures are ignored.
- `verificationStatus` isn't changed, even if the profile is already verified.

**Errors**

| Code | Message | When |
|---|---|---|
| `UNAUTHENTICATED` | You must be logged in to perform this action | No valid access token |
| `UNAUTHORIZED` | You do not have permission to perform this action | Signed in with any role other than SERVICE_PROVIDER |
| `PROVIDER_NOT_FOUND` | Provider profile not found | The account has no provider profile |
| `DOCUMENT_NOT_FOUND` | Document not found | `documentUrl` doesn't match any of the profile's documents |

### `uploadStats`

**Query** · **Who can call it:** ADMIN or SUPER_ADMIN · **Strict rate limit:** none

Counts stored profile photos, service images, provider gallery images and provider documents for the admin dashboard.

**Arguments**

None.

**Example**

```graphql
query UploadStats {
  uploadStats {
    totalProfiles
    totalServiceImages
    totalProviderImages
    totalDocuments
  }
}
```

**Success**

Response:

```json
{
  "data": {
    "uploadStats": {
      "totalProfiles": 1240,
      "totalServiceImages": 3862,
      "totalProviderImages": 978,
      "totalDocuments": 415
    }
  }
}
```

- `totalProfiles`: users with a profile photo (null and empty values aren't counted).
- `totalServiceImages`: image URLs across all services, whatever their status.
- `totalProviderImages`: image URLs across all provider galleries. It is `null` only from servers older than this field.
- `totalDocuments`: document entries across all provider profiles.
- These count saved references, not files on Cloudinary.
- No side effects.

**Errors**

| Code | Message | When |
|---|---|---|
| `UNAUTHENTICATED` | You must be logged in to perform this action | No valid access token |
| `UNAUTHORIZED` | You do not have permission to perform this action | Signed in, but not ADMIN or SUPER_ADMIN |

### `providers`

**Query** · **Who can call it:** Anyone, no token (with a valid token, the viewer's own provider profile and providers the viewer has blocked are left out) · **Strict rate limit:** none

Lists providers for the browse screen, with filters, sorting and page-based pagination. Each item includes the provider's average rating, review count and like count.

**Arguments**

| Argument | Type | Required | Rules and notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `input` | `BrowseProvidersInput` | No | Omit it to get the first 10 verified providers, newest first. |

`BrowseProvidersInput`

| Field | Type | Required | Rules and notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `filters` | `ProviderFiltersInput` | No | See the table below. |
| `sortBy` | `ProviderSortBy` | No | Default `NEWEST`. `RATING_DESC`: highest average rating first. `POPULARITY_DESC`: most likes first. `NEWEST`: most recently created profile first. `NAME_ASC`: business name A to Z. `NEAREST` has no search point here and sorts like `NEWEST`. Ties on rating or likes are newest first; other ties are settled by ID, so pages never overlap. |
| `pagination` | `PaginationInput` | No | See the table below. |

`ProviderFiltersInput`

| Field | Type | Required | Rules and notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `city` | `String` | No | Matches the whole city, ignoring case: `lagos` matches `Lagos`, `Lag` doesn't. Trimmed and cut to 200 characters. Regex special characters such as `.`, `*`, `(` and `[` are escaped first. Rejected if it contains MongoDB operator text such as `$where`, `$ne` or `$regex`. |
| `state` | `String` | No | Same rules as `city`. |
| `country` | `String` | No | Matches the whole country, ignoring case. No other checks. |
| `categoryId` | `ID` | No | Only providers with at least one `ACTIVE` service in this category. |
| `verifiedOnly` | `Boolean` | No | Default `true`: only `VERIFIED` providers. `false` returns providers with any verification status (`UNVERIFIED`, `PENDING`, `VERIFIED`, `REJECTED`). |
| `minRating` | `Float` | No | Only providers whose `averageRating`, as returned (rounded to 1 decimal place), is at least this. Providers without reviews are left out. `0` or less means no rating filter. Applied before paging, so pages are full and `total` counts only matching providers. |

`PaginationInput`

| Field | Type | Required | Rules and notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `page` | `Int` | No | Default 1. Values below 1 are treated as 1. |
| `limit` | `Int` | No | Default 10. A missing, zero or negative value uses 10; values above 100 are treated as 100. |

**Example**

```graphql
query BrowseProviders($input: BrowseProvidersInput) {
  providers(input: $input) {
    items {
      id
      businessName
      verificationStatus
      city
      state
      images
      averageRating
      totalReviews
      likeCount
      categories
      createdAt
      user {
        firstName
        lastName
        profilePhoto
      }
    }
    total
    page
    totalPages
    hasNextPage
  }
}
```

Variables:

```json
{
  "input": {
    "filters": {
      "state": "Lagos",
      "categoryId": "64e0b1a2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0",
      "minRating": 4
    },
    "sortBy": "RATING_DESC",
    "pagination": { "page": 1, "limit": 20 }
  }
}
```

**Success**

Response:

```json
{
  "data": {
    "providers": {
      "items": [
        {
          "id": "650a3b7c9d2e1f4a5b6c7d80",
          "businessName": "Chidi Okeke Plumbing",
          "verificationStatus": "VERIFIED",
          "city": "Lekki",
          "state": "Lagos",
          "images": [
            "https://res.cloudinary.com/easykonnet-demo/image/upload/v1789218000/easykonect/services/64f1c2a9e4b0a1b2c3d4e5f6_1789218000456_3fa91c.jpg"
          ],
          "averageRating": 4.8,
          "totalReviews": 36,
          "likeCount": 112,
          "categories": ["Plumbing"],
          "createdAt": "2026-03-04T09:12:45.000Z",
          "user": {
            "firstName": "Chidi",
            "lastName": "Okeke",
            "profilePhoto": null
          }
        }
      ],
      "total": 1,
      "page": 1,
      "totalPages": 1,
      "hasNextPage": false
    }
  }
}
```

- `averageRating` is the mean of the provider's review ratings rounded to 1 decimal place, or 0 with no reviews. `totalReviews` is the number of reviews. Reviews an admin has removed aren't counted in either (or in `minRating`); reviews hidden by moderation are.
- `likeCount` is the number of users who have liked the provider.
- `categories` lists the category names of the provider's `ACTIVE` services, without duplicates.
- `distanceKm` is always `null` here. `createdAt` and `updatedAt` are ISO 8601 strings.
- `address`, `latitude` and `longitude` are public on every item.
- No side effects.

**Errors**

| Code | Message | When |
|---|---|---|
| `INVALID_INPUT` | Invalid search query | `city` or `state` contains MongoDB operator text: `$where`, `$gt`, `$lt`, `$ne`, `$in`, `$nin`, `$or`, `$and`, `$not`, `$regex`, `$exists`, `$type`, `$mod`, `$text`, `$expr`, or `{` followed by `$` |
| `BAD_USER_INPUT` | input.filters.categoryId is not a valid ID | `categoryId` isn't a 24-character hex ID |

**Notes**

- An invalid or expired token isn't an error here: the request runs as signed out, so the viewer's own profile and blocked providers can appear.
- Only providers the viewer blocked are hidden, not providers who blocked the viewer.
- Open a provider with `providerProfile`, using the item's `id`.

### `providerProfile`

**Query** · **Who can call it:** Anyone, no token. Only `VERIFIED` providers are visible to everyone; the provider and admins can open a profile in any status · **Strict rate limit:** none

Loads one provider's public profile for the detail screen, including their active services.

**Arguments**

| Argument | Type | Required | Rules and notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `providerId` | `ID!` | Yes | The provider profile ID (the `id` from provider lists), not the provider's user ID. |

**Example**

```graphql
query ProviderProfile($providerId: ID!) {
  providerProfile(providerId: $providerId) {
    id
    businessName
    businessDescription
    verificationStatus
    address
    city
    state
    latitude
    longitude
    images
    averageRating
    totalReviews
    likeCount
    categories
    user {
      id
      firstName
      lastName
      profilePhoto
    }
    activeServices {
      id
      name
      price
      duration
      images
      category {
        id
        name
        slug
        description
        icon
        isActive
        createdAt
        updatedAt
      }
    }
  }
}
```

Variables:

```json
{
  "providerId": "650a3b7c9d2e1f4a5b6c7d80"
}
```

**Success**

Response:

```json
{
  "data": {
    "providerProfile": {
      "id": "650a3b7c9d2e1f4a5b6c7d80",
      "businessName": "Chidi Okeke Plumbing",
      "businessDescription": "Leak repairs, bathroom fittings and borehole pumps across Lekki and Ajah.",
      "verificationStatus": "VERIFIED",
      "address": "14 Admiralty Way, Lekki Phase 1",
      "city": "Lekki",
      "state": "Lagos",
      "latitude": 6.4474,
      "longitude": 3.4739,
      "images": [
        "https://res.cloudinary.com/easykonnet-demo/image/upload/v1789218000/easykonect/services/64f1c2a9e4b0a1b2c3d4e5f6_1789218000456_3fa91c.jpg"
      ],
      "averageRating": 4.8,
      "totalReviews": 36,
      "likeCount": 112,
      "categories": ["Plumbing"],
      "user": {
        "id": "64f1c2a9e4b0a1b2c3d4e5f6",
        "firstName": "Chidi",
        "lastName": "Okeke",
        "profilePhoto": null
      },
      "activeServices": [
        {
          "id": "651b4c8d0e3f2a5b6c7d8e91",
          "name": "Leaking Pipe Repair",
          "price": 15000,
          "duration": 90,
          "images": [
            "https://res.cloudinary.com/easykonnet-demo/image/upload/v1789218000/easykonect/services/64f1c2a9e4b0a1b2c3d4e5f6_1789218000901_c4d5e6.webp"
          ],
          "category": {
            "id": "64e0b1a2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0",
            "name": "Plumbing",
            "slug": "plumbing",
            "description": "Pipes, taps, boreholes and pumps",
            "icon": "wrench",
            "isActive": true,
            "createdAt": "2026-01-10T08:00:00.000Z",
            "updatedAt": "2026-02-01T12:30:00.000Z"
          }
        }
      ]
    }
  }
}
```

- **Who sees what:**
  - A `VERIFIED` provider is visible to everyone, signed in or not, except that a signed-in user and the provider who have blocked each other (in either direction) get `NOT_FOUND`.
  - A provider in any other status (`UNVERIFIED`, `PENDING`, `REJECTED`) is visible only to that provider and to ADMIN and SUPER_ADMIN.
  - ADMIN and SUPER_ADMIN see every profile, whatever the blocks.
- `averageRating`, `totalReviews`, `likeCount` and `categories` follow the same rules as on `providers`.
- `activeServices` holds only the provider's `ACTIVE` services. `duration` is in minutes. Every `category` field can be selected.
- `distanceKm` is always `null` here.
- No side effects.

**Errors**

| Code | Message | When |
|---|---|---|
| `BAD_USER_INPUT` | providerId is not a valid ID | `providerId` isn't a 24-character hex ID |
| `NOT_FOUND` | Provider not found | No provider has this ID; or the provider isn't `VERIFIED` and you aren't that provider or an admin; or you and the provider have blocked each other |

**Notes**

- The same `NOT_FOUND` is returned in every case, so the app can't tell a hidden profile from a missing one. Show a generic "not available" screen.
- An invalid or expired token isn't an error: the request runs as signed out, so a provider opening their own unverified profile then gets `NOT_FOUND`. Refresh the token first.
- To show whether the viewer likes this provider, call `isProviderLiked`.

### `nearbyProviders`

**Query** · **Who can call it:** Anyone, no token (with a valid token, the viewer's own provider profile and providers the viewer has blocked are left out) · **Strict rate limit:** none

Finds providers within a radius of a point, such as the device's location, with the distance on each item.

**Arguments**

| Argument | Type | Required | Rules and notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `input` | `NearbyProvidersInput!` | Yes | The search point and options. |

`NearbyProvidersInput`

| Field | Type | Required | Rules and notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `latitude` | `Float!` | Yes | Latitude of the search point in degrees. Not range-checked. |
| `longitude` | `Float!` | Yes | Longitude of the search point in degrees. Not range-checked. |
| `radiusKm` | `Float` | No | Default 25 km, maximum 100 km; larger values are treated as the maximum. Both numbers are server settings and can change. The radius used comes back as `radiusKm`. There is no minimum: 0 finds only providers at the exact point, and a negative value finds nothing. |
| `filters` | `ProviderFiltersInput` | No | Same filters and rules as on `providers`, so only `VERIFIED` providers unless `verifiedOnly` is `false`, and `minRating` is applied before the search. |
| `sortBy` | `ProviderSortBy` | No | Default `RATING_DESC`: highest average rating first. `POPULARITY_DESC`: most likes first. `NEWEST`: most recently created profile first. `NAME_ASC`: business name A to Z. `NEAREST`: nearest first. Ties on rating or likes go to the nearer provider; other ties are settled by ID. |
| `pagination` | `PaginationInput` | No | See the table below. |

`ProviderFiltersInput`

| Field | Type | Required | Rules and notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `city` | `String` | No | Matches the whole city, ignoring case. Trimmed, cut to 200 characters, regex special characters escaped. Rejected if it contains MongoDB operator text. |
| `state` | `String` | No | Same rules as `city`. |
| `country` | `String` | No | Matches the whole country, ignoring case. |
| `categoryId` | `ID` | No | Only providers with at least one `ACTIVE` service in this category. |
| `verifiedOnly` | `Boolean` | No | Default `true`: only `VERIFIED` providers. `false` includes every verification status. |
| `minRating` | `Float` | No | Only providers whose `averageRating` (rounded to 1 decimal place) is at least this. Providers without reviews are left out. `0` or less means no rating filter. |

`PaginationInput`

| Field | Type | Required | Rules and notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `page` | `Int` | No | Default 1. Values below 1 are treated as 1. |
| `limit` | `Int` | No | Default 10. A missing, zero or negative value uses 10; values above 100 are treated as 100. |

**Example**

```graphql
query NearbyProviders($input: NearbyProvidersInput!) {
  nearbyProviders(input: $input) {
    items {
      id
      businessName
      city
      latitude
      longitude
      distanceKm
      averageRating
      likeCount
      categories
      images
    }
    total
    page
    totalPages
    hasNextPage
    radiusKm
    coveredRadiusKm
    searchLocation {
      latitude
      longitude
    }
  }
}
```

Variables:

```json
{
  "input": {
    "latitude": 6.4281,
    "longitude": 3.4219,
    "radiusKm": 10,
    "filters": { "categoryId": "64e0b1a2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0" },
    "sortBy": "NEAREST",
    "pagination": { "page": 1, "limit": 20 }
  }
}
```

**Success**

Response:

```json
{
  "data": {
    "nearbyProviders": {
      "items": [
        {
          "id": "650a3b7c9d2e1f4a5b6c7d81",
          "businessName": "Tunde Bakare Pipe Works",
          "city": "Victoria Island",
          "latitude": 6.4310,
          "longitude": 3.4280,
          "distanceKm": 0.7,
          "averageRating": 4.2,
          "likeCount": 18,
          "categories": ["Plumbing", "Home Repairs"],
          "images": []
        },
        {
          "id": "650a3b7c9d2e1f4a5b6c7d80",
          "businessName": "Chidi Okeke Plumbing",
          "city": "Lekki",
          "latitude": 6.4474,
          "longitude": 3.4739,
          "distanceKm": 6.1,
          "averageRating": 4.8,
          "likeCount": 112,
          "categories": ["Plumbing"],
          "images": []
        }
      ],
      "total": 2,
      "page": 1,
      "totalPages": 1,
      "hasNextPage": false,
      "radiusKm": 10,
      "coveredRadiusKm": 10,
      "searchLocation": {
        "latitude": 6.4281,
        "longitude": 3.4219
      }
    }
  }
}
```

- `distanceKm` is the straight-line distance over the Earth's surface (Haversine formula) from the search point to the provider's saved coordinates, in kilometres rounded to 1 decimal place. Providers without saved coordinates never appear.
- `coveredRadiusKm` is how far the results reach: every matching provider within this distance is included. It equals `radiusKm` except in very dense areas (see Notes).
- `total` counts the matching providers within `coveredRadiusKm`.
- Ratings, review counts and like counts follow the same rules as on `providers`.
- `radiusKm` and `searchLocation` echo what was asked for, for text such as "Within 10 km of you".
- No side effects.

**Errors**

| Code | Message | When |
|---|---|---|
| `INVALID_INPUT` | Invalid search query | `filters.city` or `filters.state` contains MongoDB operator text (the same list as on `providers`) |
| `BAD_USER_INPUT` | input.filters.categoryId is not a valid ID | `filters.categoryId` isn't a 24-character hex ID |

**Notes**

- **Dense areas.** One search loads at most 1,000 providers. When more than 1,000 matching providers are inside the square around the search circle, the server halves the search radius, repeatedly and down to about 1 km, until they fit. Results then cover every matching provider within that smaller distance, returned as `coveredRadiusKm`. When `coveredRadiusKm` is less than `radiusKm`, say so, for example "Showing providers within 3.1 km".
- If even the smallest search area holds more than 1,000 matching providers, the same fixed 1,000 of them are searched every time.
- An invalid or expired token isn't an error: the request runs as signed out.
- To find services rather than providers, use `nearbyServices`.

### `nearbyServices`

**Query** · **Who can call it:** Anyone, no token (with a valid token, the viewer's own services and services of providers the viewer has blocked are left out) · **Strict rate limit:** none

Finds active services from verified providers near a point, nearest first, with optional category, price and text filters.

**Arguments**

| Argument | Type | Required | Rules and notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `input` | `NearbyServicesInput!` | Yes | The search point and filters. |

`NearbyServicesInput`

| Field | Type | Required | Rules and notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `latitude` | `Float!` | Yes | Latitude of the search point in degrees. Not range-checked. |
| `longitude` | `Float!` | Yes | Longitude of the search point in degrees. Not range-checked. |
| `radiusKm` | `Float` | No | Default 25 km, maximum 100 km; larger values are treated as the maximum. Both are server settings and can change. The radius used comes back as `radiusKm`. A negative value finds nothing. |
| `categoryId` | `ID` | No | Only services in this category. |
| `minPrice` | `Float` | No | Only services priced at or above this (₦). |
| `maxPrice` | `Float` | No | Only services priced at or below this (₦). Not checked against `minPrice`. |
| `search` | `String` | No | Partial match on the service name or description, ignoring case. Trimmed, cut to 200 characters, regex special characters escaped. An empty string is ignored. Rejected if it contains MongoDB operator text. |
| `pagination` | `PaginationInput` | No | See the table below. |

`PaginationInput`

| Field | Type | Required | Rules and notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `page` | `Int` | No | Default 1. Values below 1 are treated as 1. |
| `limit` | `Int` | No | Default **20** (not 10 as elsewhere). A missing, zero or negative value uses 20; values above 100 are treated as 100. |

**Example**

```graphql
query NearbyServices($input: NearbyServicesInput!) {
  nearbyServices(input: $input) {
    items {
      id
      name
      price
      duration
      images
      distanceKm
      category {
        id
        name
      }
      provider {
        id
        businessName
        city
        verificationStatus
      }
    }
    total
    page
    totalPages
    hasNextPage
    radiusKm
    searchLocation {
      latitude
      longitude
    }
  }
}
```

Variables:

```json
{
  "input": {
    "latitude": 9.0765,
    "longitude": 7.4806,
    "radiusKm": 15,
    "search": "braids",
    "minPrice": 5000,
    "maxPrice": 30000,
    "pagination": { "page": 1, "limit": 20 }
  }
}
```

**Success**

Response:

```json
{
  "data": {
    "nearbyServices": {
      "items": [
        {
          "id": "651b4c8d0e3f2a5b6c7d8ea2",
          "name": "Knotless Braids",
          "price": 25000,
          "duration": 240,
          "images": [],
          "distanceKm": 2.3,
          "category": {
            "id": "64e0b1a2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d3",
            "name": "Hair and Beauty"
          },
          "provider": {
            "id": "650a3b7c9d2e1f4a5b6c7d8f",
            "businessName": "Zainab Musa Hair Studio",
            "city": "Wuse II",
            "verificationStatus": "VERIFIED"
          }
        }
      ],
      "total": 1,
      "page": 1,
      "totalPages": 1,
      "hasNextPage": false,
      "radiusKm": 15,
      "searchLocation": {
        "latitude": 9.0765,
        "longitude": 7.4806
      }
    }
  }
}
```

- Only `ACTIVE` services whose provider is `VERIFIED` and has saved coordinates inside the radius. Results are always sorted nearest first.
- `distanceKm` is the straight-line distance to the service's provider, in kilometres rounded to 1 decimal place.
- The rating and like fields on `provider` are described in the providers and services section. `documents` on `provider` follows the rules under `uploadProviderDocuments`.
- No side effects.

**Errors**

| Code | Message | When |
|---|---|---|
| `INVALID_INPUT` | Invalid search query | `search` contains MongoDB operator text (the same list as on `providers`) |
| `BAD_USER_INPUT` | input.categoryId is not a valid ID | `categoryId` isn't a 24-character hex ID |

**Notes**

- The server loads at most 1,000 providers from the square around the circle and at most 1,000 matching services before sorting. In dense areas with a large radius, results can be incomplete and `total` too low.
- An invalid or expired token isn't an error: the request runs as signed out.

### `addFavourite`

**Mutation** · **Who can call it:** Signed-in user · **Strict rate limit:** none

Saves an active service to the signed-in user's favourites and returns the saved favourite.

**Arguments**

| Argument | Type | Required | Rules and notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `serviceId` | `ID!` | Yes | The service to save. Its status must be `ACTIVE`. |

**Example**

```graphql
mutation AddFavourite($serviceId: ID!) {
  addFavourite(serviceId: $serviceId) {
    id
    createdAt
    service {
      id
      name
      price
      status
      images
      provider {
        id
        businessName
        city
      }
    }
  }
}
```

Variables:

```json
{
  "serviceId": "651b4c8d0e3f2a5b6c7d8e91"
}
```

**Success**

Response:

```json
{
  "data": {
    "addFavourite": {
      "id": "652c5d9e1f4a3b6c7d8e9fa2",
      "createdAt": "2026-09-12T10:15:00.000Z",
      "service": {
        "id": "651b4c8d0e3f2a5b6c7d8e91",
        "name": "Leaking Pipe Repair",
        "price": 15000,
        "status": "ACTIVE",
        "images": [],
        "provider": {
          "id": "650a3b7c9d2e1f4a5b6c7d80",
          "businessName": "Chidi Okeke Plumbing",
          "city": "Lekki"
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
```

- Creates the favourite. The provider isn't notified.

**Errors**

| Code | Message | When |
|---|---|---|
| `UNAUTHENTICATED` | You must be logged in to perform this action | No valid access token |
| `BAD_USER_INPUT` | serviceId is not a valid ID | `serviceId` isn't a 24-character hex ID |
| `NOT_FOUND` | Service not found | No service has this ID |
| `SERVICE_NOT_ACTIVE` | Cannot favourite an inactive service | The service's status isn't `ACTIVE` |
| `ALREADY_FAVOURITED` | Service is already in your favourites | The user already saved this service |

**Notes**

- For a heart button, `toggleFavourite` avoids `ALREADY_FAVOURITED` on double taps. Two `addFavourite` calls at the same moment can make the second fail with an internal error instead of `ALREADY_FAVOURITED`.
- `service` fields available: `id`, `name`, `slug`, `description`, `price`, `duration`, `status`, `images`, `createdAt`, `updatedAt`, `category` (`id`, `name`, `slug`, `icon`) and `provider` (`id`, `businessName`, `verificationStatus`, `city`, `state`, `user` with `id`, `firstName`, `lastName`).

### `removeFavourite`

**Mutation** · **Who can call it:** Signed-in user · **Strict rate limit:** none

Removes a service from the signed-in user's favourites.

**Arguments**

| Argument | Type | Required | Rules and notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `serviceId` | `ID!` | Yes | The saved service. It can have any status. |

**Example**

```graphql
mutation RemoveFavourite($serviceId: ID!) {
  removeFavourite(serviceId: $serviceId) {
    success
    message
  }
}
```

Variables:

```json
{
  "serviceId": "651b4c8d0e3f2a5b6c7d8e91"
}
```

**Success**

Response:

```json
{
  "data": {
    "removeFavourite": {
      "success": true,
      "message": "Service removed from favourites successfully"
    }
  }
}
```

Message: `Service removed from favourites successfully`

- Deletes the favourite.

**Errors**

| Code | Message | When |
|---|---|---|
| `UNAUTHENTICATED` | You must be logged in to perform this action | No valid access token |
| `BAD_USER_INPUT` | serviceId is not a valid ID | `serviceId` isn't a 24-character hex ID |
| `NOT_FAVOURITED` | Service is not in your favourites | The user hasn't saved this service, or no service has this ID |

### `toggleFavourite`

**Mutation** · **Who can call it:** Signed-in user · **Strict rate limit:** none

Saves the service if the user hasn't saved it, or removes it if they have. Suited to a heart button.

**Arguments**

| Argument | Type | Required | Rules and notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `serviceId` | `ID!` | Yes | The service must exist. Adding requires status `ACTIVE`; removing works for any status. |

**Example**

```graphql
mutation ToggleFavourite($serviceId: ID!) {
  toggleFavourite(serviceId: $serviceId) {
    isFavourited
    message
  }
}
```

Variables:

```json
{
  "serviceId": "651b4c8d0e3f2a5b6c7d8e91"
}
```

**Success**

Response:

```json
{
  "data": {
    "toggleFavourite": {
      "isFavourited": true,
      "message": "Service added to favourites"
    }
  }
}
```

Messages:

- `Service added to favourites`, with `isFavourited: true`, when the favourite was created.
- `Service removed from favourites`, with `isFavourited: false`, when it was deleted.

**Errors**

| Code | Message | When |
|---|---|---|
| `UNAUTHENTICATED` | You must be logged in to perform this action | No valid access token |
| `BAD_USER_INPUT` | serviceId is not a valid ID | `serviceId` isn't a 24-character hex ID |
| `NOT_FOUND` | Service not found | No service has this ID |
| `SERVICE_NOT_ACTIVE` | Cannot favourite an inactive service | Adding a service whose status isn't `ACTIVE` |

**Notes**

- The messages differ slightly from `addFavourite` and `removeFavourite`, so don't match on message text.
- The response has no favourite ID. Call `isFavourited` if you need it.

```graphql
    hasPreviousPage
  }
}
```

```json
{
  "pagination": { "page": 1, "limit": 20 }
}
```

**Success**

Response:

```json
{
  "data": {
    "myFavourites": {
      "favourites": [
        {
          "id": "652c5d9e1f4a3b6c7d8e9fa2",
          "createdAt": "2026-09-12T10:15:00.000Z",
          "service": {
            "id": "651b4c8d0e3f2a5b6c7d8e91",
            "name": "Leaking Pipe Repair",
            "price": 15000,
            "duration": 90,
            "status": "ACTIVE",
            "images": [],
            "category": {
              "name": "Plumbing",
              "icon": null
            },
            "provider": {

              "user": {

            }

        }
      ],

      "page": 1,
      "limit": 20,
      "totalPages": 1,
      "hasNextPage": false,
      "hasPreviousPage": false
    }
  }
}
```

- The list field is `favourites`, not `items`.
- Services that are no longer `ACTIVE` stay in the list: check `service.status` before offering to book. Providers the user has blocked aren't filtered out.
- `limit` in the response is the page size actually used.
- No side effects.

**Errors**

| Code | Message | When |
|---|---|---|
| `UNAUTHENTICATED` | You must be logged in to perform this action | No valid access token |
